text: CHIEF ASSIGNMENT: claude-storymodel4s-m1 owns a docs-only design/court slice at exactly docs/design/candidate-nomination-provenance-court.md. Freeze the contract before code. Required boundaries: validate semantic scores as finite before sort/take; declare score direction and deterministic total ordering rather than inherit DeprecatedDoubleOrdering; non-finite outcomes become typed refusal/abstention with visible support consequences, never silent candidate loss or Some(NaN). Separate typed hierarchy stratum from typed derivation receipt. Derive channel/provider/geometry identities from admitted authority, not caller labels. Define a checked nomination bundle bound to exact source-view identity, recall unit/transcript identity, budgets, ordered nominations and resulting anchor set; dedup may feed inference but must not erase the receipted bundle from result/wire/output/calibration. Apply the Cartesian-product test: any audit record whose fields jointly attest a derivation must be an unforgeable final non-case class with smart construction, and future courts must compile-refuse apply, copy, companion fromProduct and Mirror.ProductOf.fromProduct with same-mechanism positive controls. Name mutations for NaN admission, hierarchy-as-receipt, provider/geometry substitution, dedup provenance erasure and forged construction. Reconcile HsmmResult and codec/schema migration surfaces, but do not implement or mint new public Scala vocabulary in this slice; any later API requires the explicit ADR 0002 line and a separately scoped candidate. Gate: git diff --check plus exact source-line checklist and independent review.
